policy.conflictRule: Apple SDK-derived evidence wins; unresolved conflicts become oracle questions, never guesses.
policy.copyRule: Use external bindings as read-only corroboration. Do not copy their implementation into a framework port.
policy.runtimeRule: Static binding metadata is not evidence for defaults, callback timing, retention, queues, hardware, services, or successful runtime behavior.
